title: High-Order Liquid Evidence Encoding for Gradual GNSS Spoofing Detection in Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2608.11790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based localization is essential for safe and reliable autonomous driving. However, spoofing attacks can manipulate vehicle position estimates. Continuous and subtle attacks are particularly difficult to detect because individual GNSS observations may remain plausible while the inconsistency between GNSS-implied displacement and onboard vehicle motion gradually increases. Existing methods often rely on static vehicle-behavior features or a single residual signal and do not explicitly model this evolution. To address this problem, we propose a causal high-order liquid evidence framework for GNSS spoofing detection. The method first constructs a physics-guided GNSS--motion inconsistency residual by comparing GNSS-implied displacement with onboard-motion-derived displacement. translated_title: 高階液體證據編碼用於自動駕駛中漸進式GNSS欺騙檢測
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11790v1 公告類型：新  摘要：基於全球導航衛星系統（GNSS）的精確定位對於安全可靠的自動駕駛至關重要。然而，欺騙攻擊可能操縱車輛位置估計。連續且微妙的攻擊特別難以檢測，因為單個GNSS觀測值可能保持合理，而GNSS隱含位移與車載運動之間的差異逐漸增加。現有方法通常依賴靜態車輛行為特徵或單一殘差信號，且未明確建模這種演變。為解決此問題，我們提出了一個因果高階液體證據框架用於GNSS欺騙檢測。該方法首先通過比較GNSS隱含位移與車載運動推導位移，構建物理引導的GNSS-運動不一致殘差。然後，它為殘差水平及其一階和二階離散變化形成獨立的證據流，以捕捉攻擊的動態演變。
tldr: 本文提出了一種因果高階液體證據框架，通過建模GNSS與車載運動殘差及其高階變化，有效檢測自動駕駛中的漸進式欺騙攻擊。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a causal high-order liquid evidence framework that models GNSS-motion inconsistency residuals and their high-order variations to effectively detect gradual spoofing attacks in autonomous driving.
